findings.title: Native CRILAYLA export reads beyond declared input length
findings.evidence: Only inputLen >=16 is required; header offset and raw-block/bitstream bounds are not checked. A safe 272-byte backing allocation passed with declared length 16 returns status 0, 256 output bytes and the marker at offset 16. The Node API path shares the unbounded pointer decoder; that path was reviewed but not independently executed.
findings.recommended_action: Use a bounded decoder; validate header sizes/offsets, signed arithmetic and every bitstream/back-reference read before allocation/copy. Initialize output slots on every failure.

findings.title: Exported version pointer refers to a movable managed array
findings.evidence: The pointer escapes a fixed block. After GC.Collect(2, Forced, true, true), CoreVersion returns a different address. Schema uses the same allocation/return pattern. The old pointer was not dereferenced after relocation.
findings.recommended_action: Keep exported strings in memory with stable lifetime (pinned/native storage), or expose a caller-owned copy API; validate the actual published NativeAOT artifact separately.

findings.title: Current workspace dependency graph is incompatible with locked resolution
findings.evidence: Online cargo check fetches missing Git dependencies, then exits 101 because Cargo.lock would require changes. Local sibling revision differs from the pinned operations revision. This does not prove that a clean checkout with the exact pinned sibling has the same failure.
findings.recommended_action: Reproduce with the declared sibling revision, then regenerate the root lock only from the intended exact graph and rerun check/clippy/test.

findings.title: Default locked solution restore fails for Debug GUI dependencies
findings.evidence: NU1004 identifies Avalonia.Diagnostics in the Debug project references but absent from the lock file. The default restore fails; the subsequent no-restore solution build also fails. Core test restore/build remains usable.
findings.recommended_action: Qualify Debug/Release dependency conditions with the owning restore/lock procedure and update the lock coherently.

findings.title: CPK invalid offsets and sizes panic instead of returning FormatError
findings.evidence: Original source in an isolated Release harness: parse_table_container([0;32], usize::MAX-8) panics at slice access; CpkReader::extract with offset=1,size=u64::MAX panics on range 1..0. Debug also panics on arithmetic overflow.
findings.recommended_action: Use checked arithmetic and checked slices; validate conversions and signed archive fields before producing entries, with malformed-input regressions.

findings.title: Exhausted CRILAYLA bitstream is accepted with fabricated zero bytes
findings.evidence: One compressed byte cannot encode the claimed 32 literal bytes. read_bits returns zero when exhausted; the decoder returns 288 output bytes. The same fixture is rejected by the original Rust CRILAYLA decoder.
findings.recommended_action: Propagate bitstream exhaustion as failure instead of synthesizing zero bits, and add the cross-language malformed-stream fixture.

findings.title: G4MD importer serializes a layout incompatible with the retained parser
findings.evidence: Importer uses header 0x44 and submesh stride 0x10; parser requires header 0xA0 and stride 0x50 with fields at different offsets. The importer is included behind IECODE_HAS_TINYGLTF, which the default core target enables. No real GLB round trip was run.
findings.recommended_action: Choose the supported format/version explicitly and qualify importer output with the owning parser and model round-trip fixtures.

findings.title: Python fallback format metadata differs from native contracts
findings.evidence: Fallback G4TX MIME is image/x-g4tx, whereas Rust scalar/descriptor MIME is image/x-level5-g4tx. The cfg.bin detection test expects the scalar/native name cfg.bin, but fallback reports RDBN; the Rust full descriptor also uses RDBN. Two assertions fail, exposing inconsistent display-name conventions as well as MIME drift.
findings.recommended_action: Derive fallback metadata from the owning catalog and define scalar/descriptor name compatibility explicitly; qualify both native and fallback paths.

findings.title: Official Python gate is blocked by the uv version pin
findings.evidence: required-version ==0.12.17 rejects the installed uv 0.12.22 before Ruff starts. Independently pinned Ruff/Pytest probes were run through uv tool run without changing the project pin.
findings.recommended_action: Requalify and align the workspace uv contract, or run the declared version in the owning workflow.

findings.title: Python native-dependent tests do not qualify a source-only checkout
findings.evidence: With PYTHONPATH set, 99 pass/17 skip/10 fail. Eight failures depend on absent Rust/.NET native libraries; no NativeAOT .so was published. Missing-artifact failures are not counted as eight independent parser defects. The recovery message requests cargo build -p nie-ffi, but the active package is aphrody-nie-ffi.
findings.recommended_action: Separate native acceptance prerequisites from pure-Python checks, then run native integration against real built artifacts rather than a mocked success. Correct the package selector in the recovery message.

findings.title: Root Python lint excludes most retained Python code
findings.evidence: Root Ruff selects 28 niepy files out of 174 tracked Python files; four other include roots no longer exist. Scripts, Blender, tools and skills are outside that baseline. Expanded scan has 82 style findings and two Ghidra-injected currentProgram references; those host globals are not confirmed execution bugs.
findings.recommended_action: Replace obsolete include roots with an explicit current owner/scope policy and preserve host-specific Ghidra/Blender assumptions.

findings.title: CRILAYLA allocation has no decoded-size budget
findings.evidence: The untrusted u32 decoded size is used for a zeroed allocation before proving the bitstream can produce it. On a 64-bit target the requested output can reach 4,294,967,551 bytes. No large allocation/OOM reproduction was attempted; C++ already applies a 256 MiB cap.
findings.recommended_action: Expose/enforce an owner-approved decoded-size budget and return an allocation/size error before materializing oversized output.

findings.title: Active UI package license-file path is missing
findings.evidence: ../../../docs/reference/iecode/NIE-LICENSE does not exist. The other declared active license files resolve correctly when interpreted relative to their manifests. This path was already missing outside the compacted historical/research trees.
findings.recommended_action: Point metadata at the actual retained license owner and verify packaging; preserve license text and ownership.

findings.title: Local Rust formatting gate fails broadly
findings.evidence: Explicitly selecting all 74 local workspace packages produces differences in 723 normalized local source paths. The separate --all command also traverses sibling path dependencies. No formatter was applied.
findings.recommended_action: Format coherent owner batches after preserving unrelated changes; do not infer correctness from a style-only change.

findings.title: Documented C++ formatting gate fails
findings.evidence: clang-format --dry-run --Werror reports violations in types.h. No broad native formatting sweep was applied.
findings.recommended_action: Normalize the relevant native owner batch and repeat the documented formatting gate.

findings.title: Managed build retains a large warning baseline
findings.evidence: 113 distinct warnings: 90 CS8618, 4 CS0108, 2 CS8602, 8 CS8509, 3 CS8600, 3 CS8524, 1 CS8601, 1 CS8604, 1 CS0659. The passing 290 core tests do not demonstrate every nullable/enum path.
findings.recommended_action: Triage warnings by runtime impact and source owner, especially dereferences and non-exhaustive switches, without fabricating unavailable game inputs.

findings.title: Portable A64 decoder source and opcode table have exact retained copies
findings.evidence: Three Rust-file duplicate groups above 500 bytes plus the identical 101,402-byte a64.inc table; total redundant bytes 112,063. Retained rdynarmic is outside the active root graph, so equality does not establish safe deletion.
findings.recommended_action: Converge through the established portable owner when the retained runtime is integrated; preserve provenance and required runtime interfaces.
